notes:
- Long-form moments are open. Each one is a whole topic of your recording (or two or three that build one idea), usually 5 to 12 minutes, with a title written for your ideal customer.
- Long-form plays as you recorded it, except your recording's own ads and calls to action, fumbles with the screen or setup, and side chatter, which come out.
- New in Creators, Editing: Outro. A short video of you that goes at the end of every long-form moment.
- Drop more than one file (a second camera, a screen recording, a call): the next question asks what each one is. Revive lines them up by their sound, shows a screen recording side by side with you while it shows something, a call only while the other person talks, and cuts between cameras to whoever is speaking.
